_notice: CURATED CATALOG DATA - this is the file actually loaded by the installed desktop app and the CLI's default catalog path (see desktop/src-tauri/src/paths.rs and src/cli/mod.rs::DEFAULT_CATALOG_PATH). It is not a live, scraped, or continuously-verified catalog. Only the qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct-q4_k_m entry's numeric fields (parameter_count, file_size_bytes) were independently verified by BRUTE itself (via `brute model inspect` against the real downloaded file on 2026-07-18 - see metadata_provenance on that entry for the exact sha256); the gemma-3-4b-it-qat-q4_0 and jais-2-8b-chat-q4_k_m entries' filenames/sizes were confirmed against the publisher's own official Hugging Face repository file listing (see their exact_artifact_url and metadata_provenance) but not independently re-downloaded/hashed by BRUTE. Every other entry's file sizes are rounded, order-of-magnitude approximations, NOT independently verified against a live file, and must be re-checked before any production use. License/commercial-use fields reflect each publisher's terms as of last_reviewed to the best of the curator's knowledge - always confirm against the official_source_url before relying on them. Synthetic/test-only entries (e.g. for exercising Unknown-license handling) live separately in data/catalog/test-fixtures.json, which no production code path ever loads - see that file's own _notice.

builds.short_description: Very small general-purpose instruct model, comfortable on almost any machine.
builds.strength: Runs comfortably on CPU-only laptops with fast responses.
builds.limitation: Noticeably weaker reasoning than larger models; not suited to complex tasks.
builds.metadata_provenance: Verified by BRUTE (brute model inspect) against the real downloaded file on 2026-07-18: sha256 74a4da8c9fdbcd15bd1f6d01d621410d31c6fc00986f5eb687824e7b93d7a9db, parameter_count and file_size_bytes are the parser's own measured values, not estimates.

builds.short_description: Higher-fidelity quantization of the same very small instruct model.
builds.strength: Closer to full-precision quality than Q4_K_M while still being tiny.
builds.limitation: Larger and slightly slower than Q4_K_M for a modest quality gain at this size.
builds.metadata_provenance: file_size_bytes approximated from parameter_count x ~1.0625 bytes/weight (published Q8_0 bpw); not independently verified against a live file in Stage 1.

builds.short_description: Full half-precision weights, no quantization loss.
builds.strength: Best achievable quality for this model size; useful as a quality baseline.
builds.limitation: 2.5x the disk/memory of Q4_K_M for a quality gain most users won't notice at this model size.
builds.metadata_provenance: file_size_bytes approximated from parameter_count x 2.0 bytes/weight (F16); not independently verified against a live file in Stage 1.

builds.short_description: Small model specialized for code completion and coding chat.
builds.strength: Noticeably better at code tasks than general models of similar size.
builds.limitation: Weaker than larger coder models on multi-file/complex refactoring tasks.
builds.metadata_provenance: parameter_count from publisher's official model card; file_size_bytes is a rounded order-of-magnitude estimate, not independently verified against a live file in Stage 1.

builds.short_description: Medium general-purpose instruct model with substantially stronger reasoning than the 0.5B-1.5B class.
builds.strength: Strong general knowledge and reasoning for its size; long native context.
builds.limitation: Requires meaningfully more RAM/VRAM and is noticeably slower on CPU-only machines.
builds.metadata_provenance: Meta's Llama 3.1 Community License restricts commercial use for organizations exceeding 700M monthly active users at the time of last_reviewed - never treat as unconditionally 'allowed'. Original weights are gated on Hugging Face (requires accepting Meta's license); GGUF conversions are community-produced from these weights. file_size_bytes is a rounded order-of-magnitude estimate, not independently verified in Stage 1.

builds.short_description: Large instruct model. Included in this dev catalog specifically as an oversized/unsupported negative test case for typical consumer hardware.
builds.strength: Strongest reasoning in this catalog when hardware genuinely supports it.
builds.limitation: Exceeds the RAM/VRAM of most consumer machines; expect Not-recommended or Unknown fit on typical hardware.
builds.metadata_provenance: Same license terms as the 8B entry - see its metadata_provenance note. file_size_bytes is a rounded order-of-magnitude estimate, not independently verified in Stage 1. Deliberately included oversized for fit-classification negative-path testing.

builds.short_description: Arabic-English bilingual chat model, officially released in GGUF format by its own publisher.
builds.strength: Purpose-built and trained for Arabic; official first-party GGUF release, not a third-party conversion.
builds.limitation: Context length (4K, per the official file listing) is short next to newer general models; exact parameter count and architecture GGUF-tag are best-effort, not independently confirmed against the file's own metadata.
builds.curator_notes: Filename and file size (5.1 GB) confirmed directly against the official inceptionai Hugging Face repository's file listing on 2026-07-18. Checksum not independently computed by BRUTE - do not treat as integrity-verified until actually downloaded and hashed.
builds.benchmark_confidence: Arabic-capability rating is based on the model's stated purpose and training focus, not an independent BRUTE benchmark.
builds.metadata_provenance: Repository and filename confirmed via direct Hugging Face file-listing lookup on 2026-07-18. parameter_count (8B) is from the model name, not an exact published figure. Never independently downloaded or hashed by BRUTE.

builds.publisher: National Center for Artificial Intelligence (NCAI), Saudi Data and AI Authority (SDAIA)
builds.short_description: Saudi national Arabic-English LLM. SDAIA's official release is base weights only - no official GGUF, only community conversions exist.
builds.strength: Developed specifically to advance Arabic language technology by a national research center; base weights and license are publisher-verified.
builds.limitation: No first-party GGUF artifact exists yet - BRUTE cannot offer a direct verified download for this entry, only a pointer to the official source and an unverified community conversion's expected size.
builds.curator_notes: The official ALLaM-AI/ALLaM-7B-Instruct-preview repository confirmed via direct fetch on 2026-07-18 (license: apache-2.0, 7B params, 4096-token context, developed by NCAI/SDAIA). Community GGUF conversions exist (e.g. under third-party uploader accounts) but are NOT independently verified by BRUTE and are deliberately not linked here as an exact_artifact_url - this entry intentionally has no Download-eligible artifact. Architecture tag (llama) is a best-effort assumption, not confirmed against actual GGUF metadata.
builds.benchmark_confidence: Arabic-capability rating is based on the model's stated national-Arabic-LLM purpose, not an independent BRUTE benchmark.
builds.metadata_provenance: Base-model facts (license, parameter count, context length, publisher) confirmed via direct Hugging Face page fetch on 2026-07-18. file_size_bytes is BRUTE's own estimate (parameter_count x ~0.6 bytes/weight for Q4_K_M), not from any real downloaded or listed file - no first-party GGUF exists to measure.

builds.short_description: Google's official quantization-aware-trained GGUF release; strong multilingual support and native vision input.
builds.strength: Official first-party GGUF from the publisher itself (not a community conversion); quantization-aware training means less quality loss than typical post-hoc quantization; genuinely multimodal.
builds.limitation: Gated on Hugging Face (requires accepting Google's Gemma Terms of Use before download); vision input requires also fetching the separate mmproj file, which BRUTE does not currently manage.
builds.curator_notes: Filename and file size (3.16 GB) confirmed directly against the official google Hugging Face repository's file listing on 2026-07-18. The repository also contains a separate mmproj-model-f16-4B.gguf (851 MB) required for vision input, which this catalog entry does not represent separately. Commercial use is marked restricted, not allowed - the Gemma Terms of Use permit commercial use but attach a Prohibited Use Policy and redistribution conditions, which this schema's 'allowed' value is reserved for licenses without such conditions (e.g. Apache/MIT).
builds.benchmark_confidence: reasoning/general_quality ratings are based on Google's own published model positioning, not an independent BRUTE benchmark.
builds.metadata_provenance: Repository, filename, and file size confirmed via direct Hugging Face file-listing lookup on 2026-07-18. parameter_count (4B) and context_length (128K) are from Google's public model documentation, not independently measured. Never independently downloaded or hashed by BRUTE.

builds.short_description: Small, permissively-licensed model with an unusually long 128K context window; no official first-party GGUF yet.
builds.strength: MIT license (unconditionally permissive); long context makes it comfortable for document-heavy use at a small size.
builds.limitation: Microsoft has not published an official GGUF - only community conversions exist, so BRUTE cannot offer a direct verified download for this entry.
builds.curator_notes: The official microsoft/Phi-4-mini-instruct repository confirmed via direct fetch on 2026-07-18 (license: MIT, 3.8B params, 128K context). Community GGUF conversions exist under third-party uploader accounts but are NOT independently verified by BRUTE and are deliberately not linked here as an exact_artifact_url. Architecture tag (phi3) is a best-effort assumption based on the Phi model family's known llama.cpp support, not confirmed against this specific build's own GGUF metadata.
builds.benchmark_confidence: Capability ratings are based on Microsoft's own published model positioning (small, efficient, reasoning-focused), not an independent BRUTE benchmark. speed_category=fast is inferred from the small parameter count, not measured.
builds.metadata_provenance: Base-model facts (license, parameter count, context length) confirmed via direct Hugging Face page fetch on 2026-07-18. file_size_bytes is BRUTE's own estimate (parameter_count x ~0.6 bytes/weight for Q4_K_M), not from any real downloaded or listed file - no first-party GGUF exists to measure.
